review_rules: Green Pact practice must distinguish theological ideal, regional custom, historical practice and individual interpretation
Do not treat every Bosmer as observing the Green Pact identically across eras and communities
Spinner stories may have unusual relationships to history and possibility, but narrative claims still retain speaker and context provenance
Wild Hunt accounts should distinguish witnessed transformations, historical reports, ritual doctrine and later retellings
Silvenar and Green Lady are offices/roles as well as individuals in particular periods; model office identity separately from officeholders
Cross-link existing Bosmer, Valenwood, Green Pact, Y'ffre, Wild Hunt, Camoran, Grahtwood, Elden Root, Silvenar and Green Lady records
